(Japanese: '''えんまくの中のバトル''' ''Battle in the Smokescreen'') is the sixteenth chapter of the [[Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!]] manga.

==Plot==
The chapter begins with [[Shu]] and {{TP|Shu|Pikachu}} battling a group of {{p|Zubat}} in a cave. After Shu manages to capture one, he hears a mysterious voice calling out to him by name from deep within the cave. It turns out to be somebody riding a {{p|Dragonite}}. Shu approaches the mysterious person, who continues to taunt him. He reveals his name to be {{GDZ|Ken}}, and Shu challenges him to a battle.

Ken sends out a {{p|Koffing}} and commands it to use {{m|Smokescreen}}, completely blocking Shu's view. As Shu is trying to plan his next move, the ground starts rumbling. At the same time, something unseen starts flying around and hitting Shu and Pikachu. Ken reveals that behind the smokescreen, he has Shu surrounded by Pokémon - {{p|Pidgeotto}} from above, {{p|Cubone}} on the sides, and {{p|Dugtrio}} underground. Realizing that he needs to get rid of the fog created by Koffing's SmokeScreen before he will be able to fight back, Shu sends out his newly caught Zubat. Since Zubat can use {{wp|echolocation}} to navigate even in the dark, it is able to pinpoint the location of Koffing. Now knowing where to strike, Shu commands Pikachu to use {{m|Thunder}}, defeating Koffing.

The fog disappears, and Shu is nowhere to be found. He appears on top of {{p|Ponyta}}, who has jumped high above Ken's head. Shu commands Pikachu to use {{m|Thunderbolt}}, defeating the rest of Ken's Pokémon. As a prize for winning, Ken gives Shu a signed guitar, which he considers extremely valuable. As Ken walks away, Shu comments to Pikachu that the guitar is completely useless to him.

==Major events==
* Shu captures a Zubat.
* Shu meets Ken and challenges him to a battle.
